introduction:
Introduction About FEXUCLUE TABLET

Fexuclue Tablet (Fexuprazan) is a modern acid-control medicine formulated for people who experience persistent acid-related discomfort despite lifestyle changes or conventional options. It belongs to a newer class called potassium-competitive acid blockers (P-CABs), developed to provide faster and more consistent gastric acid suppression. This makes Fexuclue particularly relevant for individuals with frequent heartburn, acid reflux–related symptoms, or conditions where sustained acid control is important for daily comfort and quality of life.

Fexuprazan works by directly blocking the H/K-ATPase (proton pump) in stomach parietal cells, the final step responsible for acid secretion. Clinical data show that P-CABs like fexuprazan can achieve rapid onset of acid suppression from the first dose and maintain stable gastric pH over 24 hours, including nighttime periods. Fexuclue is commonly considered for adults with gastro-esophageal reflux symptoms, acid-related gastritis, or those who require predictable, day-long acid control. It may also be suitable for patients who do not experience adequate symptom consistency with traditional proton pump inhibitors.

Fexuclue is usually taken once daily, with or without food, as advised by a healthcare professional. The tablet should be swallowed whole with water and taken at the same time each day for best results. Patients are advised not to crush or chew the tablet. During use, precautions such as limiting alcohol intake, avoiding very late-night meals, and reducing spicy or high-fat foods may help improve overall symptom control. Inform your doctor about any existing liver conditions or other long-term medicines before starting Fexuclue.

Commonly reported side effects are generally mild and may include headache, diarrhoea, abdominal discomfort, nausea, or bloating, which often resolve as the body adjusts. Use during pregnancy and breastfeeding should only be considered if clearly advised by a doctor, as human safety data are limited. Long-term or unsupervised use is not recommended without medical guidance. If symptoms persist, worsen, or new discomfort appears, timely medical consultation is important to ensure appropriate ongoing care.

mechanismOfAction:
How FEXUCLUE TABLET Works
Mechanism of Action of Fexuclue Tablet (Fexuprazan)

Fexuclue Tablet contains fexuprazan, a next-generation potassium-competitive acid blocker (P-CAB) that works by directly targeting acid-producing cells in the stomach. It selectively blocks the H/K-ATPase enzyme (proton pump) present on gastric parietal cells, which plays a key role in the final step of gastric acid secretion. 

Unlike conventional acid-suppressing medicines that require activation in an acidic environment, fexuprazan acts rapidly and reversibly by competing with potassium ions at the proton pump site. This results in fast, consistent, and sustained reduction of gastric acid output throughout the day and night.

By maintaining a more stable gastric pH, fexuprazan helps create a favorable environment for esophageal and gastric lining comfort, supports healing conditions associated with excess acid, and reduces acid-related discomfort after meals. Its predictable acid control profile also contributes to improved symptom consistency, even with once-daily dosing.

Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water. Do not crush, chew, or break it unless your doctor advises.
It can be taken with or without food, but try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent acid control.
Do not take more than the prescribed dose. Taking extra tablets will not increase effectiveness and may increase side effects.
If you forget a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is almost time for the next dose, skip the missed one.
Do not stop the medicine suddenly without consulting your doctor, especially if you have been taking it regularly.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding duration of use, even if symptoms improve before completing the course.
Report any unusual symptoms or persistent discomfort to your doctor promptly.

Common Side Effects of Fexuclue Tablet

• Headache
• Diarrhoea
• Nausea
• Abdominal discomfort or bloating
• Dizziness

When to Seek Medical Attention?

Stop taking Fexuclue Tablet and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

• Severe or persistent abdominal pain
• Black or bloody stools
• Persistent vomiting or vomiting blood
• Difficulty in swallowing or chest discomfort that worsens
• Sudden unexplained weight loss
• Signs of an allergic reaction such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face or throat, or breathing difficulty

name: VONEFI 20 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About VONEFI 20 TABLET

VONEFI 20 TABLET is used in the management of Gastro-intestinal reflux disease (GERD), reflux or erosive esophagitis, heartburn, acidity, stomach ulcers and other complications caused due to excessive stomach acid secretions. It can also be used as an adjunctive therapy for eradication of Helicobacter pylori infection in combination with antibiotics (like amoxicillin and clarithromycin).

VONEFI 20 TABLET contains Vonoprazan which is a Potassium Competitive Acid Blocker (P-CAB). It works by blocking a specific protein in the stomach lining which is crucial for producing stomach acid. By inhibiting it, vonoprazan effectively reduces the amount of acid the stomach produces.

Vonoprazan reduces stomach acid more effectively than traditional proton pump inhibitors (PPIs), creating a less acidic environment which helps the antibiotics work better by increasing their stability and concentration in the stomach, making it easier to eradicate the H. pylori bacteria. VONEFI 20 TABLET is suitable for use only in adults.

Before taking VONEFI 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood magnesium levels, calcium and potassium levels or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking VONEFI 20 TABLET are stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhea, constipation, bloating, high blood pressure, headache, changes in taste sense, vaginal yeast infection and cold-like symptoms. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About ERDOSTYNE 300MG CAPSULE

ERDOSTYNE 300MG CAPSULE is used to manage the symptoms associated with short, severe episodes of worsening of chronic bronchitis. It contains Erdosteine which belongs to the group of medicines known as Mucolytic agents which acts on the phlegm (mucus) in the respiratory tract or airways.

ERDOSTYNE 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems, kidney impairment or stomach ulcer. ERDOSTYNE 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking the medicine.

ERDOSTYNE 300MG CAPSULE is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age. The most common side effect of taking ERDOSTYNE 300MG CAPSULE is epigastric pain. Consult your doctor if the above side effects persists for a longer duration.

Introduction About MUCOEND 600 TABLET

MUCOEND 600 TABLET contains Acetylcysteine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Mucolytics. It is used in adults to manage acute airway diseases such as bronchitis (inflammation of the mucous membrane in the airways), emphysema, mucoviscidosis (cystic fibrosis), and/or bronchiectasis (chronic widening of the airway passage).

MUCOEND 600 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients allergic to Acetylcysteine. It is also not recommended for use in patients with bronchial asthma. Before taking MUCOEND 600 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have stomach ulcers, liver diseases (such as non-alcoholic fatty acid disease), or chronic kidney disease.

MUCOEND 600 TABLET should be used with caution by pregnant and breastfeeding women only if it is clearly necessary. This medicine is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years) and is advised to be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 60 years) after consulting your doctor. The most common side effects of taking MUCOEND 600 TABLET are nausea and vomiting. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Introduction About SILODERM CREAM

Siloderm Cream is a skin protective cream that is used to relieve nappy rash, contact dermatitis, bed sore, detergent dermatitis, peri-anal dermatitis, cracked feet, lacerations (wound), etc. It contains calamine, cetrimide, dimethicone, and zinc oxide as active ingredients that soothe, heal, and protect the skin.

Dimethicone protects the skin against contact with irritants or allergens and maintains moisture by forming a barrier over the skin and reducing the amount of water the skin loses. Zinc possesses anti-bacterial and anti-inflammatory properties and offers light protection.

Calamine has astringent, antibacterial, moisturizing, antipruritic, antiseptic and protective effects that are used to manage skin exudation, rashes, and itching. Cetrimide has many antibacterial, antifungal, and antiviral properties that helps avoid or minimize the risk of infection.

Always use Siloderm Cream exactly as directed by your physician. It is for external use only. Avoid direct application into nostrils, eyes and mucous membranes. It should not be used by pregnant women, breastfeeding women, infants, children, adolescents and elderly without doctor’s advice.

mechanismOfAction:
How STARIZO 200 TABLET Works

This medicine works by targeting the specific problem that causes the infection in your body. After you take the tablet, it gets absorbed into your bloodstream and reaches the affected area. Once it reaches the infection site, it enters the harmful organisms responsible for causing the illness.

Inside these organisms, the medicine blocks the essential steps they need to grow and multiply. It interferes with their internal processes, stopping them from producing the proteins and structures required for survival. Because of this, the infection-causing organisms weaken, stop multiplying, and eventually die off.

As the number of harmful organisms decreases, your body’s natural defense system becomes more effective at clearing the remaining infection. This helps reduce symptoms and supports your recovery. The medicine is designed to work in a targeted way, so it focuses mainly on the organisms causing the infection without affecting your healthy cells.

You may take it at any time of the day, but it should be taken at the same time every day. Choose a time that is easy to remember morning or night is both acceptable.

More Information
Myth vs Facts

Myth 1: “I must take STARIZO 200 only on an empty stomach.”

Fact: The tablet can be taken with or without food. Your doctor may guide you based on your comfort, routine, or other medicines you take.

Myth 2: “If I feel better after one or two doses, I can stop the medicine.”

Fact: Stopping early may not allow your body to fully clear the infection-causing organisms. Completing the full course, as advised by your doctor, ensures better results.

Myth 3: “Older adults should avoid STARIZO 200.”

Fact: Older adults can use the tablet with proper monitoring. Dose adjustments are usually not required unless advised by a doctor.

Myth 4: “It is unsafe for people with kidney or liver concerns.”

Fact: People with kidney or liver issues can take STARIZO 200, but they may require monitoring. Your doctor will guide you based on your health condition.

Myth 5: “This medicine works instantly after the first dose.”

Fact: While many people start feeling better early, the medicine works gradually by reducing the activity of infection-causing organisms. Consistency is more important than speed.

Points to Remember – STARIZO 200 Tablet

Before You Start Using This Medicine

Inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver, heart, or lung conditions.
Share a complete list of all prescription, OTC medicines, supplements, and herbal products you take.
Mention if you are pregnant, planning pregnancy, or breastfeeding.
Avoid self-adjusting the dose; always follow doctor’s guidance.
Check the expiry date and packaging integrity before use.
Keep the tablet out of reach of children.

While Using This Medicine

Take the tablet exactly as prescribed, with or without food.
Swallow the tablet whole with a glass of water; do not crush or chew.
Maintain consistent timing each day to keep levels steady.
If you experience dizziness or tiredness, avoid driving or operating heavy machinery.
Limit alcohol consumption as it may increase side effects like dizziness.
Report any unusual body reactions, such as persistent nausea, rash, or yellowing of eyes/skin, to your doctor.
Do not skip doses; if a dose is missed, take it as soon as remembered unless it is almost time for the next dose.

After Using This Medicine

Complete the full course as prescribed, even if you feel better early.
Store the remaining tablets in a cool, dry place, away from sunlight and moisture.
Continue to monitor your overall well-being and report any delayed reactions to your healthcare provider.
Dispose of any unused or expired tablets safely, following local regulations or pharmacy advice.
Schedule follow-up appointments if your doctor recommends monitoring kidney, liver, or blood parameters.
The Science Behind How STARIZO 200 Tablet Works
Tedizolid phosphate, a broad-spectrum oxazolidinone antibiotic offers antibacterial activity against the most important ABSSSIs pathogens including MRSA & some linezolid-resistant S. aureus and cfr-mediated & vancomycin-resistant enterococci.
Tedizolid has potent activity against gram-positive cocci, offers high oral bioavailability, convenience of once a day dosing, lower risk of drug-drug interactions, better safety profile at 6 days compared to 10 days with linezolid.
This makes tedizolid an attractive alternative for ABSSSI

Hypersensitivity to Tedizolid 200 mg or to any of the excipients

Tedizolid phosphate is a prodrug that is rapidly converted by endogenous phosphatases to tedizolid, the microbiologically active moiety.
10 Tedizolid, a bacteriostatic antibiotic inhibits bacterial protein synthesis by acting on the initiation step of protein synthesis.
Tedizolid, binds to the 23S ribosomal RNA of the 50S subunit & inhibits its activity, avoiding its association with the 30S subunit. Thus, the formation of a functional 70S initiation complex that initiates protein synthesis in the bacteria is stopped.

Patients should be advised that antibacterial drugs including Tedizolid should only be used to manage bacterial infections.
Tedizolid does not manage viral infections (e.g., the common cold). When Tedizolid is prescribed to manage a bacterial infection, patients should be told that although it is common to feel better early in the course of therapy, the medication should be taken exactly as directed.

Introduction About VOZAN 20 TABLET

VOZAN 20 TABLET is used in the management of Gastro-intestinal reflux disease (GERD), reflux or erosive esophagitis, heartburn, acidity, stomach ulcers and other complications caused due to excessive stomach acid secretions. It can also be used as an adjunctive therapy for eradication of Helicobacter pylori infection in combination with antibiotics (like amoxicillin and clarithromycin).

VOZAN 20 TABLET contains Vonoprazan which is a Potassium Competitive Acid Blocker (P-CAB). It works by blocking a specific protein in the stomach lining which is crucial for producing stomach acid. By inhibiting it, vonoprazan effectively reduces the amount of acid the stomach produces.

Vonoprazan reduces stomach acid more effectively than traditional proton pump inhibitors (PPIs), creating a less acidic environment which helps the antibiotics work better by increasing their stability and concentration in the stomach, making it easier to eradicate the H. pylori bacteria. VOZAN 20 TABLET is suitable for use only in adults.

Before taking VOZAN 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood magnesium levels, calcium and potassium levels or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking VOZAN 20 TABLET are stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhea, constipation, bloating, high blood pressure, headache, changes in taste sense, vaginal yeast infection and cold-like symptoms. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

warnings.details: Pregnant women should use DOMI DT DISPERSIBLE TABLET only if necessary under medical supervision. It crosses the placenta, and while no major birth defects have been reported, studies on its safety in pregnancy are limited. Doctors may prescribe it only if the benefits outweigh the risks, particularly in cases of severe nausea and vomiting (morning sickness or hyperemesis gravidarum).

Breastfeeding mothers should discuss the risks with their doctor. If prescribed while breastfeeding, monitor the baby for any unusual symptoms and seek pediatric advice if needed. DOMI DT DISPERSIBLE TABLET passes into breast milk in small amounts, so caution is advised. It is sometimes prescribed to increase breast milk production (off-label use), but its safety for this purpose is debated. Potential risks for the baby may cause drowsiness, irritability, or digestive issues in infants, long-term effects on breastfed babies are not well studied.

BLOCPRO 5 TABLET is a prescription medication primarily used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and heart conditions such as angina (chest pain) and heart failure. It belongs to a group of medicines called beta-blockers.

BLOCPRO 5 TABLET can be prescribed alone or with other medications. The dose and how often you take it depend on your condition and its severity. It is best taken in the morning with or without food, but be sure to take it at the same time every day for the best results. It may take several weeks to feel the full effects, and you may need to take it long-term. Even if you feel fine, it is important to keep taking it, as most people with high blood pressure do not feel sick, and stopping could make your condition worse.

The most common side effects of this medicine include dizziness or lightheadedness, fatigue, bradycardia (slow heart rate), headache, nausea. However, these are temporary and usually resolve on their own. Please consult your doctor if these do not resolve or persist for a longer duration. To reduce the risk of side effects your doctor will probably start the medicine at a low dose and gradually increase it.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver issues, low blood pressure, very slow heart rate, severe circulation problems, severe heart failure. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also consult their doctor before taking it. Regular blood pressure checks are recommended to ensure the medication is effective. It is best to avoid alcohol, as it could worsen certain side effects.

Introduction About VOCAB 20 TABLET

VOCAB 20 TABLET is used in the management of Gastro-intestinal reflux disease (GERD), reflux or erosive esophagitis, heartburn, acidity, stomach ulcers and other complications caused due to excessive stomach acid secretions. It can also be used as an adjunctive therapy for eradication of Helicobacter pylori infection in combination with antibiotics (like amoxicillin and clarithromycin).

VOCAB 20 TABLET contains Vonoprazan which is a Potassium Competitive Acid Blocker (P-CAB). It works by blocking a specific protein in the stomach lining which is crucial for producing stomach acid. By inhibiting it, vonoprazan effectively reduces the amount of acid the stomach produces.

Vonoprazan reduces stomach acid more effectively than traditional proton pump inhibitors (PPIs), creating a less acidic environment which helps the antibiotics work better by increasing their stability and concentration in the stomach, making it easier to eradicate the H. pylori bacteria. VOCAB 20 TABLET is suitable for use only in adults.

Before taking VOCAB 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have low blood magnesium levels, calcium and potassium levels or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking VOCAB 20 TABLET are stomach pain, indigestion, diarrhea, constipation, bloating, high blood pressure, headache, changes in taste sense, vaginal yeast infection and cold-like symptoms. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Introduction About VAGESTON

VAGESTON is used in the management of female infertility and other progesterone deficiency states such as abnormal uterine bleeding, menopausal disorders and secondary amenorrhea in combination with estrogen therapy. It also supports the early stages of pregnancy and reduces the risk of threatened abortions and pre-term delivery in pregnant women.

It contains a medicine called progesterone which is a steroid hormone that functions similar to the endogenous female sex hormones.

Before taking VAGESTON inform your doctor if you have any liver, heart or kidney problems, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, or depression. Do not take VAGESTON if you have or previously had breast cancer, uterine cancer, unexplained vaginal bleeding, or blood clots. During management with VAGESTON, your doctor will instruct you to have periodic blood tests and regular physical examination (breast and uterine examination) as a precaution.

VAGESTON may be prescribed by your doctor during early stages of pregnancy to support the growth of fetus. However, consult your doctor before taking it. VAGESTON is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women and in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age).

The most common side effects of taking VAGESTON are headache, hair loss, pain in the breast, stomach or abdominal cramps, bloating, nausea, vomiting, irregular vaginal bleeding or spotting, fluid retention and vaginal yeast infection. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

PANTOBERT 40 TABLET contains Pantoprazole, which belongs to the group of medicines called proton pump inhibitors. It is also prescribed to control stomach ulcers and acidity that can occur with long-term use of painkillers. Pantoprazole works by reducing the amount of acid produced in the stomach, thereby providing relief from symptoms associated with these acid-related disorders.

For optimal effect, take this medicine one hour before meals, preferably in the morning. The dosage will be determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to management. Continue taking PANTOBERT 40 TABLET as directed, even if your symptoms improve quickly. You can help enhance the effectiveness of your management by eating smaller, more frequent meals and avoiding caffeinated beverages (such as tea and coffee), as well as spicy or fatty foods.  

The most common side effects observed with this medicine include nausea, vomiting, headache, dizziness, flatulence, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, and rash. These effects are usually mild, but if they persist or become bothersome, consult your doctor. Prolonged use of this medication may increase the risk of certain side effects, for example, taking it for more than one year, especially at higher doses, may raise your risk of bone fractures. Discuss management measures for bone loss, such as calcium and vitamin D supplementation, with your doctor if you require long-term management.

Before taking PANTOBERT 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, are taking medicines for HIV, have a history of allergic reactions to pantoprazole or other proton pump inhibitors, or suffer from bone loss (osteoporosis). How PANTOBERT 40 TABLET Works

PANTOBERT 40 TABLET contains pantoprazole, which is a proton pump inhibitor (PPI). It works by specifically targeting and blocking the proton pumps (H+/K+ ATPase enzymes) located in the stomach lining, which are responsible for the final step in the production of gastric acid.

Pantoprazole Mechanism of Action Explained:
Pantoprazole accumulates in the acidic environment of the stomach’s parietal cells, where it is converted to its active form. This active form binds irreversibly to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also known as the gastric proton pump, on the secretory surface of the parietal cell. By forming covalent bonds with this enzyme, pantoprazole effectively inactivates it, thereby blocking both basal and stimulated acid secretion.

Understanding Proton Pump Inhibition:
Proton pumps are specialized enzymes (H+/K+ ATPase) found in the stomach’s parietal cells. They are responsible for the final step in the secretion of hydrochloric acid (HCl) into the stomach. By inhibiting these pumps, pantoprazole stops the secretion of acid regardless of the original stimulus, leading to a significant and sustained reduction in stomach acidity.

Role of H+/K+ ATPase in Acid Secretion:
The H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, also called the gastric proton pump, exchanges hydrogen ions (protons) from the parietal cell with potassium ions from the stomach lumen. This exchange results in the secretion of hydrochloric acid, which is essential for digestion but can cause problems like ulcers and acid reflux if produced in excess. Pantoprazole’s action on this enzyme interrupts this process, reducing acid output.

Why PANTOBERT 40 TABLET Is Effective for Acid Control:
PANTOBERT 40 TABLET effectiveness stems from its ability to irreversibly inhibit the proton pumps, resulting in a longer-lasting suppression of acid production compared to other classes of acid-reducing drugs. Since new pumps must be synthesized by the body before acid secretion can resume, the acid-suppressing effect persists for over 24 hours, even after the drug has been cleared from the bloodstream.

What Happens in the Stomach When You Take PANTOBERT 40 TABLET?
After ingestion, pantoprazole is absorbed and transported to the parietal cells in the stomach. In the acidic environment of these cells, it is activated and binds to the H+/K+ ATPase enzyme, inactivating it. This leads to a marked reduction in gastric acid secretion, which helps relieve symptoms of acid reflux, heartburn, and promotes the healing of ulcers and esophagitis.

Duration and Effectiveness of Pantoprazole:
Pantoprazole has a relatively long duration of action due to its irreversible binding to the proton pump. Its acid-suppressing effects last for more than 24 hours, even though its plasma half-life is only about two hours. This allows for convenient once-daily dosing, and its efficacy is comparable to other PPIs, making it a reliable option for both short-term and long-term management of acid-related disorders.

Introduction About TYVALZI 30MCG INJECTION

TYVALZI Injection is used in the management of Acute Cerebral Ischemic Stroke, a condition in which the loss of blood supply to the brain manages brain tissue from receiving oxygen and nutrients, resulting in potential brain damage. It contains a medicine called Sovateltide which stimulates the production of neural progenitor cells in the brain, supporting the generation of new brain cells and blood vessels post-cerebral ischemic stroke. This process enhances blood flow to the brain, promoting the survival of brain cells.

Studies have shown that, TYVALZI has anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activity which helps in limiting brain cell damage and potentially restoring neurological and motor function in patients following a stroke.

TYVALZI Injection will be given to you only a trained doctor or by any competent healthcare professional into your veins (i.v.) as an intravenous bolus over one minute.

While undergoing therapy with TYVALZI Injection, it is important to take all doses exactly in the same dosing intervals as suggested by your doctor to see better results. Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you any bleeding in the brain or any other pre-existing disease conditions as a precaution.

There is no study information regarding the use of TYVALZI during pregnant, breastfeeding and in children (aged below 18 years). Therefore, inform your doctor before this medicine is administered to you.

TYVALZI Injection is generally well tolerated. If you experience any unpleasant side effects, consult your doctor.

It works by making your body produce neural progenitor cells - a type of cells in the brain that has the potential to develop into essential brain cells (various types of glial and neuronal cells) that populate the CNS.

This action of Sovateltide help in production of new brain cells and blood vessels, following cerebral ischemic stroke, hence increasing blood flow to the brain and maintains brain cells survival.

TYVALZI Injection should be used under medical supervision.

Therapy with TYVALZI should be initiated within 24 hours of stroke onset, after the first day of management, repeat doses should be administered on day 3 and day 6 of the stroke. A total of nine doses of Tyvalzi should be administered. Therefore, it is important to closely follow the dosing information advised by your doctor for maximum benefits.

Introduction About LACTULAC SOLUTION

LACTULAC SOLUTION contains Lactulose, which belongs to the group of medicines called Laxatives. It is used to manage constipation (infrequent bowel movements, hard and dry stools) and hepatic encephalopathy. Hepatic encephalopathy is a decline in brain function due to liver disease that causes symptoms like confusion, tremor, and decreased level of consciousness; it can also lead to hepatic coma.

LACTULAC SOLUTION is not recommended for use in patients with serious genetic disorders where you cannot digest galactose (galactosaemia), acute inflammatory bowel disease, blockage in the bowels (apart from normal constipation), gastro-intestinal perforation, or risk of perforation or stomach pain due to an unknown cause. During management with LACTULAC SOLUTION, you should drink enough fluids (about 6–8 glasses).

Before taking LACTULAC SOLUTION, inform your doctor if you are lactose intolerant or have diabetes or Roemheld syndrome. LACTULAC SOLUTION should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women only if clearly advised by the doctor. LACTULAC SOLUTION is usually not recommended for use in infants and smaller children, but your child’s doctor may prescribe in certain circumstances.

It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above), and your doctor may check your blood electrolytes when this medicine is taken for more than 6 months or patients with bad general conditions.

The most common side effects of taking LACTULAC SOLUTION are flatulence, stomach pain, nausea, vomiting, or diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About SPARK GEL

SPARK Gel is used to manage pain, swelling, and inflammation due to musculo-skeletal disorders such as sprains, strains, tendonitis, bursitis, hand, neck, shoulder pain, sciatica, muscle stiffness, joint pain, and backache. It contains Diclofenac Diethylamine, Linseed Oil, Menthol, and Methyl Salicylate, which is a combination of Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs, analgesics, and counter-irritants.

SPARK Gel is not recommended for use during pregnancy, particularly during the third trimester of the pregnancy. SPARK Gel should be used during breastfeeding only if it is clearly necessary and under medical supervision.

SPARK Gel is not recommended for use if you have attacks of asthma, urticaria, or acute rhinitis after using acetylsalicylic acid or other NSAIDs (aspirin-sensitive asthma). It should be used with caution in patients with pre-existing asthma (without aspirin sensitivity). Consult your doctor before using it.

SPARK Gel should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. It is not recommended for use in patients with advanced renal disease unless clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before using it.

SPARK Gel should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before using it.

The safety and effectiveness of SPARK Gel in children under the age of 14 years are not established. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of applying SPARK Gel are application site reactions, including skin irritation, rash, dermatitis, pruritus, erythema, paraesthesia, vesicles, papules, redness or swelling, and burning or stinging sensations. Consult your doctor before using it.

mechanismOfAction:
How SPARK GEL Works

Diclofenac and methyl salicylate work by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX), resulting in the reduced formation of prostaglandins, which are responsible for pain and inflammation. Linseed oil produces anti-inflammatory and analgesic effects and helps reduce pain and inflammation. Linseed oil also softens the skin and thus soothes skin irritation.

Methyl salicylate produces a rubefacient effect by reddening the skin by dilatation of the blood vessels and giving a soothing feeling of warmth. Methyl salicylate also produces a counterirritant effect by causing irritation of the sensory nerve endings, which alters pain in the underlying muscles or joints that are served by the same nerves. Menthol acts as a rubefacient and causes localized vasodilatation, which gives feelings of comfort and warmth. Menthol produces a counter-irritant effect by imparting a cooling effect and by initially stimulating nociceptors and then desensitizing them.

Apply SPARK Gel as advised by your doctor. It is for external use only. Gently rub a small quantity of the gel on the intact skin, on or around the painful or swollen area, till the gel disappears. It should be applied 3–4 times daily or as directed by the doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of management depending on your age, body weight, and disease condition. Do not exceed the recommended dosage. After application, the hands should be washed unless they are the site being managed.

Introduction About SIOMOV GEL

SIOMOV GEL is indicated to provide relief from acute musculoskeletal disorders such as sprains, strains, tendonitis, shoulder pain, bursitis, hand, neck, sciatica, muscle stiffness, joint pain, backache, and pain of osteoarthritis of joints. It is a combination of Diclofenac, Linseed Oil, Menthol and Methyl Salicylate which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory (NSAID) and Analgesics preparations.

SIOMOV GEL is not recommended for use in patients who have advanced kidney disease, asthma, urticaria (allergic reaction) after use of NSAIDs such as aspirin, coronary artery bypass graft surgery, or have broken or irritated skin. 

SIOMOV GEL should not be used in pregnant women, especially in late pregnancy and in breast-feeding women. It should not be used in children under 2 years of age or in children with flu, chickenpox, or fever. 

Caution must be exercised while using SIOMOV GEL in elderly patients. The most common side effects of using SIOMOV GEL are skin rash, oedema, wheals, papules (a tender bump), scaly skin, reddening of the skin, itching, or a prickling sensation that may occur at the site of application. Ask for your doctor’s advice if any of these don’t improve or worsen.

How SIOMOV GEL Works

SIOMOV GEL helps in relieving aches and pain. Diclofenac is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug that causes relief from pain and inflammation by inhibiting the factors that cause inflammation and pain called prostaglandins. Linseed oil has anti-inflammatory effects, antioxidant properties, and improves blood circulation at the site of application. Methyl salicylate is a counterirritant and causes irritation of the skin, and as a result of the counterirritation, there is a sensation of warmth and relief in musculoskeletal pain. Menthol dilates the blood vessels, causing a sensation of coldness followed by an analgesic effect.

Avoid contact with this medicine in your eyes, ears, nose, and mouth.

Your doctor will decide the duration and frequency of the management depending on your age and disease condition.

The symptoms of bacterial infection include fever, difficulty breathing, pus formation, and pain.

TOXO MOX 250 (VET) TABLET is not recommended for use if you have liver problems or jaundice upon taking an antibiotic or amoxicillin-clavulanate. Introduction About NEO HCG 10000IU INJECTION 1ML

NEO HCG 10000IU INJECTION 1ML contains Chorionic Gonadotropin which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropins. It is used to manage hypogonadism (deficiency of sex hormones) in men. It also helps in the release of matured ovum (eggs) from the ovaries (ovulation) among infertile women after undergoing premanagement with suitable hormonal medicines (such as menotropins or FSH).

It also helps in sustaining pregnancy during the early stages among women who experience habitual abortions. It can also be used in the management of prepubertal cryptorchidism (failure of testis to descend into the scrotum) caused due to hormone deficiency in young male children (aged between 4-9 years).

During management with NEO HCG 10000IU INJECTION 1ML, your doctor would monitor your health condition through several blood test and ultrasound to avoid the risk of side effects like fluid accumulation, abnormally enlarged ovarian follicles or multiple pregnancies (pregnant with more than one child), especially if you are undergoing assisted reproductive techniques.

Before receiving NEO HCG 10000IU INJECTION 1ML inform your doctor if you have any forms of cancer in the ovaries, uterus, breasts or prostate. You must also inform your doctor if you have any damage in the fallopian tubes, as management with NEO HCG 10000IU INJECTION 1ML may cause ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside of the womb) in such cases.

NEO HCG 10000IU INJECTION 1ML may cause false positive pregnant result in women who take pregnancy test using their blood or urine. This effect may last up to 10 days even after discontinuing management with NEO HCG 10000IU INJECTION 1ML.

NEO HCG 10000IU INJECTION 1ML may be used to sustain pregnancy during the initial stages (luteal phase). However, it should not be used on the later stages of pregnancy. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of NEO HCG 10000IU INJECTION 1ML are reaching puberty at an early age, pain at the injection site, headache and irritability. Consult your doctor if they worsen.

Introduction About NEO HCG 2000IU INJECTION 1ML

NEO HCG 2000IU INJECTION 1ML contains Chorionic Gonadotropin which belongs to the group of medicines called Gonadotropins. It is used to manage hypogonadism (deficiency of sex hormones) in men. It also helps in the release of matured ovum (eggs) from the ovaries (ovulation) among infertile women after undergoing premanagement with suitable hormonal medicines (such as menotropins or FSH).

It also helps in sustaining pregnancy during the early stages among women who experience habitual abortions. It can also be used in the management of prepubertal cryptorchidism (failure of testis to descend into the scrotum) caused due to hormone deficiency in young male children (aged between 4-9 years).

During management with NEO HCG 2000IU INJECTION 1ML, your doctor would monitor your health condition through several blood test and ultrasound to avoid the risk of side effects like fluid accumulation, abnormally enlarged ovarian follicles or multiple pregnancies (pregnant with more than one child), especially if you are undergoing assisted reproductive techniques.

Before receiving NEO HCG 2000IU INJECTION 1ML inform your doctor if you have any forms of cancer in the ovaries, uterus, breasts or prostate. You must also inform your doctor if you have any damage in the fallopian tubes, as management with NEO HCG 2000IU INJECTION 1ML may cause ectopic pregnancy (pregnancy outside of the womb) in such cases.

NEO HCG 2000IU INJECTION 1ML may cause false positive pregnant result in women who take pregnancy test using their blood or urine. This effect may last up to 10 days even after discontinuing management with NEO HCG 2000IU INJECTION 1ML.

NEO HCG 2000IU INJECTION 1ML may be used to sustain pregnancy during the initial stages (luteal phase). However, it should not be used on the later stages of pregnancy. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

The most common side effects of NEO HCG 2000IU INJECTION 1ML are reaching puberty at an early age, pain at the injection site, headache and irritability. Consult your doctor if they worsen.

How NEO HCG 2000IU INJECTION 1ML Works

NEO HCG 2000IU INJECTION 1ML is a gonadotrophic hormone which stimulates the production of sex hormones in both men and women. In men, it acts by stimulating the release of androgens which are responsible for the development of secondary sexual characteristics and for regulating the onset of puberty. It also helps to move down the testicles into the scrotum in children having undescended testis.

In women, it triggers the release of matured egg from the ovaries and helps to sustain pregnancy by supplementing enough female sex hormones (estrogen and progesterone) which are required for maintaining a successful conception.

Introduction About ELDOFEN ADVANCE SPRAY

Eldofen Advance Spray is a pain killer used for local symptomatic relief of musculoskeletal pain such as back pain, ankle pain, knee pain, shoulder pain and wrist pain due to muscle stiffness, strains, and sports injury. It contains Diclofenac, Methyl Salicylate, Menthol as active ingredients.

Diclofenac and Methyl salicylate reduces the formation of prostaglandins (certain chemicals which are responsible to cause pain and swelling). Menthol dilates the blood vessels causing a sensation of coldness, followed by a pain-relieving effect.

Hold upright and spray away from face. Spray the contents on the affected area 3-4 times a day or as directed by the physician. Cover sprayed area with cloth to improve drug penetration and effectiveness. Do not spray on open wounds. It is for external use only. Shake well before use. Avoid direct application into nostrils, eyes and mucous membranes. Do not spray on broken skin and open wounds. Do not swallow, inhale or spray Eldofen Advance Spary on the face and near the eyes.
